stories.title: Bird keepers across Wales must follow new bird flu rules from Monday
stories.summary: Anyone in Wales who keeps chickens, ducks, geese or other birds must follow new rules to stop the spread of bird flu from midday on Monday 16 November, however few birds they have. stories.title: Flintshire Cabinet accused of shelving school transport review until after election
stories.summary: The motion says a working group's recommendations missed an October deadline because Cabinet would not put them out to consultation.

stories.title: Flintshire Bridge back open following earlier incident
stories.summary: Update: The bridge has now reopened. Earlier report: The Flintshire Bridge is closed in both directions because of an incident on the A548 in Connah’s Quay, police have said. North Wales Police’s North Flintshire team said officers were at the scene on Friday afternoon. The team said: Please avoid the area for the time being

stories.title: Rocks thrown at houses and passing cars, Penyffordd councillor says
stories.summary: Rocks were thrown at houses, parked cars and passing traffic on Chester Road in Penyffordd, a local councillor has said. Cllr Roy Wakelam (Penyffordd, Independent) said in a post on Facebook that several teenagers were hammering on doors on the Millstone View estate and running off at about 9.30pm. stories.title: Update: A494 back open in Gwernymynydd following earlier collision
stories.summary: Update: Traffic maps show vehicles are now moving freely on the A494 in Gwernymynydd following an earlier closure. Earlier report: The A494 is blocked in both directions in Gwernymynydd, near Mold, after a collision. The road is blocked between Maeshafn Road and Hafod Road, and traffic is queueing.
